verdict.rationale: Riskified's Chargeback Gateway Integration (CGI) is documented as automating end-to-end chargeback handling — from receiving chargeback notifications to the disputing process — across major gateways, and the platform separately ingests order, session (Beacon), and decision data used in fraud review, implying this data feeds dispute evidence submission. However, the docs never explicitly describe compiling delivery/session evidence into a dispute package or confirm no manual review step is needed before issuer submission. Missing for 10: explicit description of evidence compilation format sent to issuers, confirmation of zero manual intervention, and independent/hands-on verification that the automated dispute submission works end-to-end.
